Helix.text:
WHAT: Vision Language Action (VLA) model
CATEGORY: Robotics
FEATURES: Can adapt to different real-world challenges, can isolate and reorient objects, can handle fragile items, can recover from errors
CAPABILITIES: Loading a dishwasher, folding laundry, rearranging packages
USERS: Home and global workforce
NOTE: Can learn new capabilities with additional data
